Projects staged observation, understanding and practice independently.

patterns.failure_checks: Check teacher double-booking, changed learner state, unavailable reference, cancellation and failed publication. No arbitrary lifetime apprenticeship limit.

Change funds or participant support after display and confirm stale/refused choice spends nothing. Failure and success lead to correctly different later useful actions. Save/reload/Export/literal Import at a pending response and after payment preserve cursor, stock and consequence. A failed durable write publishes neither host effect nor cursor.

seams.shown: Stages input reservation, use, repeat and cancellation on cloned stock.
Validates and writes the full envelope before publishing staged state.

games.implementation: Food and alchemy recipes create competing uses; summons can support research or examination.
Earlier gathering and production feed later systems, with personal and shared consumers.
Research/design, physical equipment stock and production are separate; family switches can lose continuity.
Paid trades and personal work can train alike, but workshop output requires loaded real materials.

Cooking has usable intermediate transformation states; smelting separates fuel, pending count, finished stock, per-unit remainder, cancel and collect; exact debit multipliers/capacity failure remain partial.

Finish one paid alternative and use its output in an existing task; ordinary use stays available. Optional furnace follow-on: distinguish committed inputs, fuel, remaining work and uncollected output; fuel exhaustion pauses, collect transfers only finished goods, cancellation returns only declared unprocessed inputs. This is a separate leaf, not a required expansion of the two-destination proof.

patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 show held quantity, two destination quotes, costs and actual result together; retain ordinary crafting controls.
patterns.done_check: Acquire the input naturally; exercise both routes in separate fresh runs and a shortage refusal. Each consumes the same actual stock once, produces a different useful consequence and survives Save/reload/Export/literal Import, including interrupted reservation.
patterns.failure_checks: Check cancellation, full output capacity and failed durable publication. Toolkit sacrifice specifically still needs its upstream caller read; the generic competing-use packet does not claim that trace.

patterns.title: Separate discovery, permission, ownership and present usability
patterns.payoff_reason: Current command preview and observer-safe requirements already provide most of the route. It can make blocked play understandable with little new state.

seams.shown: Separates visibleWhen from actual eligibility and checks actor, target, site, body context and costs.
Known ways are projected without naming undiscovered alternatives.

games.implementation: Some feature buttons appear before permanent loot-use unlock; current-run boss gates differ from persistent unlocks.
World/actor admission, discovery visibility and availability have separate authored checks.
Path rules separate owning a tool, legally using it, transformed effects and aftercore retention.
Rumour/search/location/access differ; translation can improve search without a universal plot lock.
Property title does not override door permission or jurisdictional exclusion.

patterns.scope: For one already learned tool-dependent action, display known, permitted and usable states from existing admission. Removing the tool or access shows the specific known missing means and a supported alternative.
patterns.save_compatibility: Prefer zero new save bytes. Keep current knowledge and title/custody state; regain access without relearning. New local permission, if actually missing, is optional scoped state with an issuer and absent default.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 the action, known blocker, currently held means and alternative are simultaneously visible; use words as well as color.
patterns.done_check: Learn naturally, execute, lose only means/access, observe truthful refusal with no spend, regain means and execute again. Preview and stale commit agree. Save/reload/Export/literal Import preserve learned versus usable state.
patterns.failure_checks: No unknown row/count/OR-branch disclosure; queued execution rechecks the same actual predicate.

patterns.payoff_reason: Existing observer-safe projections support a bounded practical inference. New interpretation semantics require a real appraisal consumer.

seams.shown: Projects observer-qualified retained accounts and revisions.
Uses witnessed people projections rather than exposing the raw registry.

Local market truth and cause-linked acquired price information differ; a dated report needs its own observer record.
History text reads committed culture/religion/date facts; map-derived picture clues are later development claims.
Speaker/listener/subject directed gossip effects differ from omniscient relationship or knowledge updates.
Occurrence, sourced information instance, holder knowledge, transmission and public broadcast have separate consumers; duplicate same-occurrence knowledge is rejected.

patterns.save_compatibility: Add only optional claim status/support/supersedes fields where current observation records lack them. Legacy confirmed observations remain confirmed; no reinterpretation from display prose. Same source ID cannot become two independent confirmations.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 observation, proposed interpretation, known supporting source and useful action remain visible; longer revision history scrolls locally.
patterns.done_check: Naturally observe, act on a plausible reading, acquire independent evidence, correct it and use the changed appraisal. Save/reload/Export/literal Import retain old and corrected accounts plus actual consequence. Sorting/rendering never draws RNG or reveals truth.
patterns.failure_checks: Check repeated observation, absent source, hearsay, hidden counts and event time versus reveal time. No full language engine required.

seams.shown: Finds known request outcomes not already consumed by an aftermath response.
Binds delivered versus declined history to distinct road-advice responses.

games.implementation: Focus/decision/event effects retain scoped flags, relations and modifiers for later campaign actions.
Expired event 801125 creates persistent successor 801300; package semantics and interpreter remain unread.
Book incidents reenacted with local responsive activity; a global advancing novel chronology is not proven.
Public technologies can outlive personal rebirth, with different regression rules.

patterns.save_compatibility: Old settled requests keep their recorded outcome; no fabricated historical timeout. New optional occurrence stores deadline/result/cause, absent means legacy behavior. Never drive rewards from lossy biography.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 show known promise/time and later changed service beside ordinary actions. Reveal aftermath through an earned visit/report, not a global hidden-state dashboard.
patterns.done_check: Play fulfilled, decline and miss routes on separate disposable origins; later service checks the actual outcome. Save/reload/Export/literal Import before deadline and after aftermath retain cause and avoid duplicate grants.
patterns.failure_checks: Early cancellation is not timeout; retry/revisit remains possible under new causal stock and conditions. Do not invent offscreen death.

patterns.title: Institutions provide services through separate rights and support
patterns.payoff_reason: Makes existing relations and workshop access practical; one local permission leaf avoids building a universal faction system.

seams.shown: Applies a concrete institutional closure reason to supported work.
Existing effects include scoped knowledge, relationships, claims, items and resources.

games.implementation: Aggregate sect support affects teaching grade and reading; personal affection remains separate.
Merit thresholds, teacher relationship and favor redemption have separate consumers.
Title, invitation and jurisdiction differ; city offices have local authority rather than one universal election model.
Sect development rewards bind facility recovery to classes/trade; exact execution untraced.
Companion support and authored quests affect methods and availability; universal re-recruitment not established.

patterns.scope: One known institution has a service and an actual previously earned gift/object. Disclosed eligibility can close or reopen the service; the object follows its own return/retention terms. Show a supported way to repair access.
patterns.save_compatibility: Keep directed relations, item custody and institutional eligibility separate. Add a versioned local permission only if current facts cannot express it. Old saves gain neither a free gift nor retroactive service debt.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 display known service terms, current eligibility cause, held object and repair route together. No hidden faction standings.
patterns.done_check: Claim under terms, lose eligibility, inspect exact object retention or return, regain service and use it. No duplicate gift on reopening. Save/reload/Export/literal Import preserve all three owners independently.
patterns.failure_checks: Institutional restriction does not erase private knowledge or title; old generic closure flags must not become a global faction model.

patterns.payoff_reason: Prevents misleading event behavior while reusing the storylet deck. Rich priority policy needs an explicit change rather than being assumed present.

seams.shown: Filters requires, once, cooldown and already-open instances, then computes weights.
Cadence, quiet outcomes, open-event budget, draw receipts and emission are distinct.
Existing response route owns event settlement.

games.implementation: Eligibility, category/priority selection, roll cadence, event/step/choice history and closure have separate consumers.
Triggered-only events, mission timeouts, on-actions and scoped flags assemble chains; engine runtime untraced.
Daily Luck frequency gate precedes uniform selection among eligible unplayed records.
Shared versus per-source allowances and reset boundaries show scoped recurrence, not a source-read event scheduler.
Turn events leave quiet slots; explore events redraw rejected candidates; a petition validates 100 gold and consumes one visitor. Full branch cooldown/caller matrix remains partial.

patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 show current known offer, its remaining time, refusal/acceptance and relevant result; no debug candidate pool or undiscovered count.

Close one occurrence once and reach a later supported occurrence. Pending and final Save/reload/Export/literal Import preserve draws, deadline and payout.

Per-call slot weights are not per-year rates; rejected-turn candidates stay quiet while exploration candidates may redraw. KoL remains client-side recurrence evidence. Check closure and later valid occurrence separately.

Projects the agreed command, active job, pause reason and retained result.

Workers, skill, facility maintenance and capacity jointly control village output.
Present clique expertise changes adventure options; pair conflicts alter group availability.
Mobilization menus name productive residents and military/economic loops; exact missed-income arithmetic remains unread.

Cancel/complete releases only owned reservations. Save/reload/Export/literal Import preserve participants, stock and knowledge boundaries.

Independent queues and manual/AHA allocations differ; offline permissions are per activity.
Finite targets return allocation/capacity; completion and later allocation are separate decisions.
Routine alternates scenes, combat, selling and buying through a common queue.

Pause mode pays no next-job cost even on a large advance; notify does not stop existing lawful work. Manual action remains usable. Save/reload/Export/literal Import retain intent/cursor with no duplicate settlement.
patterns.failure_checks: No pause toggling from repeated callbacks, automatic consequential answer or extra scheduler. Full parser/editor remains U17 follow-on.

Define excess-work policy locally and link one actual unlocked action.

patterns.failure_checks: Check affordability before cost-dependent XP, missing support and no unconditional XP merely from opening a view. No compulsory click variety or hunger death.

patterns.payoff_reason: Broad recurrence with existing preview/commit seams. Strong value, but whole-life transfer has more proof cost than a work projection.

Rechecks sequence and changes selected mastery, reserve and legacy through caller publication.
Campaign transitions have separate safe-boundary and lost/retained projections.

Save/SaveR split and ten resource exceptions; remembered class permission differs from proficiency.

Each skill receives its own retained multiplier gain based on research and current-life ship kills.
Succession has explicit channels for skills, goods, village assets and selected bonds, not blanket relation copying.

patterns.save_compatibility: Pure projection initially; preserve existing once-claim semantics and old saves. This local source currently rejects a second renewal; repeatable variants require a new explicit rule/revision, not removing a claim silently. Any future carrier changes need field-level compatibility.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 current/next/lost/retained values and confirm/cancel stay visible together; known blocked commitments have a useful return link.

patterns.failure_checks: Failed publication changes neither mastery nor legacy. Local renewal proof does not establish estate succession, world travel, repeated reset or broader inheritance.

patterns.title: A sourced message separates delivery, reading and acting
patterns.payoff_reason: Adds useful delayed story without interrupting every task; current event feed and observer knowledge can carry one report.

seams.shown: Projects discovered events, opportunities and completed receipts, not private future outcomes.
Retains cause-linked, audience-qualified outcomes and avoids duplicate operation identity.
Existing scheduler is the due-work owner; no second message timer is needed.

PaperBird definitions and MessageSO schema distinguish delayed message arrival, options, conditions and scripts; actual message graph corpus was not recovered.
Threshold sender retains filename and rumor even when its modal is suppressed; text delivery is not a player reply graph.
An occurrence, sourced information instance, receiver knowledge and public dissemination have separate identities and effects.

patterns.scope: One existing known worker sends one cause-linked report after real completion. Arrival adds a feed entry; reading reveals only the report, while collecting goods or accepting work calls its existing separate action. Reopening is allowed. A muted popup does not block delivery or earned knowledge.
patterns.save_compatibility: Optional message ID/cause/sender/recipient/due/received/read state belongs to current world/actor owners, default empty. Preserve attachment custody references rather than copying stock. Do not infer old letters or knowledge from shared quest completion.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 current task, unread report indicator, readable report and separate useful follow-up are visible without a compulsory modal.
patterns.done_check: Complete a natural job; deliver once, suppress popup in a control, read twice, and separately collect/use actual output. An uninformed other actor gains nothing. Pending delivery and read-but-uncollected Save/reload/Export/literal Import preserve due time, audience and goods.
patterns.failure_checks: Unknown sender/source facts stay unknown. Delivery is not reading, reading is not claiming, and a report is not ground truth. Use world game time with an explicit coalesce/replay rule.

patterns.title: Ambient speech arbitrates context without replacing causal state
patterns.payoff_reason: Small world-life gain with existing feed/observations; lower priority than useful choices because text alone adds no mechanical depth.

seams.shown: Observer disclosure is explicit; private facts cannot become public lines.
Existing candidate filtering/cooldown and weighted family logic is an incumbent, not a reason for a second generic bark scheduler.

games.implementation: Reactive speech uses perception/language/recipient guards and first-match triggers; weighted idle/combat stories are distinct.
Monster context selects bark keys and perceptual channels; silent visual and unseen visual cues differ.
Acknowledgement candidates have rule type, actor, score, cooldown and mission suppression; units and MaxCount sentinel semantics untraced.

Separate eligible context, speaker/audience, priority, local repetition memory and presentation. Reuse an existing event route only if it fits; do not make speech a reward source.
patterns.save_compatibility: At most one optional scoped last-spoken/cause record under current actor/world state, absent means no remembered bark. Knowledge and paid outcome already live elsewhere; losing transient text never loses an earned method.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 short speech stays beside the current action without covering controls. Text is readable independently of sound, color or animation; no voice asset dependency.
patterns.done_check: Naturally cause a witnessed result, compare visible/heard-only/unseen states, and present one appropriate line. Repeated repaint/duplicate delivery stays quiet; changed valid context can speak again. Save/reload/Export/literal Import preserve selected recurrence without replaying payment or exposing unknown facts.
patterns.failure_checks: Random flavor must use separate nonmechanical selection or retained addressed outcome; opening UI cannot move gameplay RNG. Do not copy source lifetime caps or infer relationship AI from barks.

patterns.title: Restore interpreter, host state and pending decisions coherently
patterns.payoff_reason: Useful scoped hardening of current narrative persistence; distinct from adding a new scene or a profile wrapper.

Copies native envelope, writes staged expansion/money/items and validates before storage; caller publishes after success.
Exact beginning identity/revision/hash remains a separate compatibility owner.

Controller-owned save bytes include dialogue choice history, pending production and world state in one coordinated dictionary; direct write atomicity unproved.
Allocate GUID objects, overlay mutable data, restore ordered systems and rebuild derived state; metadata/content versions differ.
Entity-ID merge before validation can partly mutate state; retaining bad input text is not rollback.
Dialogue screen clears stale reflection callbacks; five binary save domains and backups have no proved cross-file epoch transaction.

Audit every current save/import route for cursor + host effect + pending job + actual native inventory. Add only the missing compatible field/admission check, if any; if all meet the gate, record a source confirmation and remaining native proof.

Missing content returns safe recovery with original cursor and paid effects intact. Derived UI may rebuild; authoritative consequences cannot be reconstructed from transcript. A full profile is not required for this local gate.
patterns.desktop_1366x768_gate: At 1366x768 pending choice, already-paid result, resume/blocker and recovery message are readable alongside actual current stock; no silent start-over fallback.

Save/reload/Export/literal Import preserve supported host/cursor/stock; synthetic incompatible-content and malformed-cursor imports reject without replacing target. Faulted write publishes neither cursor nor host result.
patterns.failure_checks: An accepted threaded save request elsewhere is not durable completion. Checksums/versions/temporary paths alone do not close this gate; use actual-loader validation and exact retained definitions.

patterns.title: Content overlays are ordered, typed and checked before activation
patterns.payoff_reason: Broad authoring payoff with low runtime scope if kept offline. New evidence identifies actual list-replacement, deletion-format and repeated-ID traps.

seams.shown: Current registry validates stable typed definitions and freezes admitted records.
Saved identity/hash/revision mismatch preserves a character for compatible recovery.
